text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The PlayStation 2 was released in 2000 and became the best-selling home console of all time. It introduced DVD playback as a major feature and offered a large library covering nearly every genre. The system featured major franchises including Grand Theft Auto, Gran Turismo, Final Fantasy, Metal Gear Solid, God of War, Kingdom Hearts, Tekken, and Ratchet & Clank. Its backward compatibility with PlayStation games helped create a smooth transition from Sony's first console. Multiple revisions including the slim model extended the system's lifespan, allowing it to remain popular well into the seventh generation.
